Has been assessed as competent to undertake electrical 
installation work, supervision, and inspection duties in 
accordance with the National Electrical Code, Electrical 
Safety Regulations, and applicable state legislation.

License Category: Master Electrician Supervision  
Authorization: Unlimited 
Voltage Rating: Up to 1000V AC/DC
Training Hours: 180 Hours
 Practical Assessment: Passed with Distinction
 Written Examination: 94%

This certificate is subject to renewal every three years and requires 
compliance with continuing professional development requirements.
